    AI Overview
    Scottie Scheffler has won the Masters Tournament twice, securing the green jacket in 2022 and 2024. Known for his dominance at Augusta National, he won his first title by three strokes and his second by four strokes. 
    • 2022 Masters: Scheffler won his first major championship, finishing at 10-under par.
    • 2024 Masters: He secured his second title with a 4-under 68 in the final round, finishing at 11-under par.
    • 2026 Masters: Scheffler finished as runner-up to Rory McIlroy. During this tournament, he achieved a historic feat by playing the final two rounds without a bogey, a first since 1942. 
    As of April 2026, he is a two-time Masters champion
